c74object.name: mUnit.handler
c74object.digest: Run a suite of mUnit asserts and write the results
c74object.description: mUnit.handler orchestrates a suite of tests: it registers every mUnit.assert and mUnit.assert~ that loads, collects their verdicts, and writes the results and the captured Max console when the run finishes. A run finishes exactly once: when every registered assert has reported and no assert has registered or reported for settleMs, or when suiteTimeout expires, in which case every unfinished assert is reported as failed, so a CI run always ends. Each assert is posted to the Max console as it finishes (ok, FAIL with the reason, or skip). The result files (results.json, or results.xml with the JUnit formatter, and log.txt) are fully written, the mUnit.teardown hooks have run and the DSP settings are restored before the right outlet bangs. The handler needs a configuration before the tests start: mUnit.harness reads munit.config.js from its patch's folder, or send a dict with the configure message. The left outlet bangs when the handler is ready, which is also what fires every mUnit.loadbang. Keep one handler open at a time: asserts register with whichever handler is running. The command-line runner (munit run, from the munit-cli npm package or javascript/nodejs/runner/munit-cli.js in this package) starts Max, runs a suite, quits Max and exits with a code for CI.

outlet.digest: Bang when the handler is ready and the tests may start
outlet.description: Sent once the handler has started and been configured. mUnit.loadbang fires at the same moment, in every open patch.

outlet.digest: Bang when the suite has finished and the results are written

method.name: configure
method.description: The dict holds the same keys as munit.config.js: logFormatter, resultFormatter ("Json", "JUnit" or "Html"), ignoreConsoleErrors, logOutputFilters, logObjectFilters, outputDir, settleMs, suiteTimeout, teardownMs, dsp, runFolder, takeReferences and forbidOnly. A dict has no folder to resolve relative paths against, so outputDir must be absolute (a leading ~ is expanded). An invalid configuration is rejected with a message in the Max console that says what is wrong, and the tests do not start; unknown keys are reported as warnings. Send it as configure followed by the dict, e.g. through prepend.

method.name: takeReferences
method.description: With no argument or a non-zero one, the asserts that register next take their references: snapshots and reference comparisons write what they get as their reference, and pass. 0 switches it off. The same as munit run --take-references or takeReferences: true in the configuration.

method.name: reset
method.digest: Forget the current run and start a new one
method.description: Clears the registrations, results and log, keeps the configuration, and announces ready again. mUnit.harness sends it when it runs again.

method.name: hydrateConfiguration
method.description: Sent by mUnit.harness. The file is read fresh each time, so edits apply without restarting node.script; without the file, the defaults apply.

method.name: start
method.digest: Internal: the ready broadcast has gone out
method.description: Sent by the handler patcher itself; opens the settle window that ends the suite.

method.name: hold
method.digest: Internal: hold the run open (sequential harness)
method.description: Sent by mUnit.harness in sequential mode, with mark as each patch opens and done when all have run.

entry.name: logFormatter, resultFormatter
entry.description: "Txt" for the log; "Json" (default), "JUnit" or "Html" for the results, or a formatter object with render() and fileExtension(); a list of these writes one results file each. JUnit writes one testsuite per @suite, with failures, skips and attachments linked for CI.

entry.name: outputDir, runFolder
entry.description: Where the files go (default: logs/ next to munit.config.js). With runFolder, each run writes to a timestamped subfolder. Files an assert keeps with a failure go to artifacts/<uuid>/.

entry.name: settleMs, suiteTimeout, teardownMs
entry.description: Quiet time that ends the suite (default 1000); the watchdog (default 300000, 0 disables); how long to wait for mUnit.teardown hooks (default 2000, 0 doesn't wait).

entry.name: ignoreConsoleErrors, logOutputFilters, logObjectFilters
entry.description: With ignoreConsoleErrors false, any error in the Max console fails the suite (default true). Output filters are regexes whose matching lines are left out of the written log; object filters name Max objects whose console output is not captured (default ["node.script"]).

entry.name: dsp
entry.description: { driver, sr, vs, settleMs }: audio settings applied when the suite starts, with DSP switched on, and restored after the teardowns. "NonRealTime" needs no hardware and renders as fast as the machine can.

entry.name: takeReferences, forbidOnly
entry.description: Take references: snapshots and reference comparisons write what they get, and pass; fail the suite if any assert has @only.

entry.name: bang
entry.description: Out left outlet: a bang once the handler has started and been configured, so the tests may start. mUnit.loadbang fires at the same moment, in every open patch.

entry.name: bang
entry.description: Out right outlet: a bang when the suite has finished and the result files are written.
